sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Granby Selectboard members: Reginald Bunnell (Chair), Tyler Fournier, and R. Terry Williams. Granby has no official website in any source read; this is a Bloomfield-shape SOS build. The factory prints 'Raymond "Terry" Williams'; the directory form governs.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Town Clerk Contact Info' spreadsheet: lists Terri Williams as Granby Town Clerk.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Terri Lynn Williams as Granby Town Clerk (January 2026). She is a distinct person from Selectboard member R. Terry (Raymond) Williams: different full names and roles.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Treasurers' Contact Info' spreadsheet: lists Terri Williams as Granby's Treasurer.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Terri Lynn Williams as Granby Town Treasurer (January 2026).
